svg.title: Final upper- and lower-bound performance profiles
svg.desc: Two performance profiles over all 480 PSPLIB J30 instances. The horizontal axes give the relative gap of each method to the known optimum: (UB minus optimum) divided by the optimum, and (optimum minus LB) divided by the optimum, in percent. A gap of zero means that the bound equals the optimum. The insets enlarge the 99 through 100 percent tails. Color identifies the search method, while line style identifies the LP configuration.
